delayed_entry_events.close_above_reference: first post-signal candle whose close >= reference_price
delayed_entry_events.reclaim_after_retrace: first post-signal candle whose close >= reference_price after at least one candle closed below reference_price
delayed_entry_events.retest_bounce: first post-signal candle whose low <= reference_price*(1+tol) and close >= reference_price for tolerance in {0.002,0.005,0.01}
delayed_entry_events.micro_body_confirm: first post-signal candle with bullish body (close > open) AND close >= reference_price

meta.no_hindsight_rule: All path computations use only candles strictly after signal_time. Retest zones use signal-time reference_price only. Delayed-entry events are online-computable.
